# Aarin Mahala

> Founder of stationerywala.shop, Full-Stack Developer, and Computer Science (AI & ML) student based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Tech collaborator with Indian Army (2nd Lancers).

Aarin Mahala builds modern web experiences, e-commerce platforms, and embedded IoT solutions. He founded stationerywala.shop and collaborated with the Indian Army (2nd Lancers - Gardner's Horse) on an indigenous GSM-GPS drone tracking module.

## Key Projects

- [StationeryWala](https://www.stationerywala.shop): Fast, responsive e-commerce platform for student stationery built with Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.
- [GEC Barmer College Website](https://college-website-pd4czgj4p-aarin-mahalas-projects.vercel.app): Modern portal for Government Engineering College Barmer.
- [Flashcard Engine](https://flashcard-engine-bay.vercel.app): Spaced repetition study application with Pomodoro timer.
- [GYM Management System](https://gym-management-system-phi.vercel.app): Role-based management dashboard with billing and member tracking.
- [Rajasthan Virtual Shiksha](https://rajasthan-virtual-shiksha.vercel.app): Offline-capable PWA educational platform for remote students.
- [MAD Duck Game](https://madduck.vercel.app): Interactive HTML5 Canvas browser game.

## Experience & Collaboration

- [Indian Army Tech Collaboration](https://aarinmahala.vercel.app#work): 45-day defense project developing a Smart GSM-GPS Drone Tracking & Recording module with 2nd Lancers (Gardner's Horse), earning an official Appreciation Letter.
- [Unified Mentor Internship](https://aarinmahala.vercel.app#work): Full Stack Developer intern building full-stack web applications with React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
- [Vijay Kiran and Company](https://aarinmahala.vercel.app#work): Graphic Design Specialist & Account Handler for e-commerce photography and digital brand presence.
- [Freelance Web Development](https://aarinmahala.vercel.app#work): Custom business web applications, portfolios, and SEO optimization.
